caption: The drawing on the jug depicts a central figure of a soldier in uniform, holding a sword in his right hand and a flag in his left, standing near a cannon with cannonballs at his feet. In the background, there is a battlefield scene with another soldier beside the cannon and a group of ships at sea, as well as a fort-like structure. The soldier is framed by a decorative oval border comprised of an alternating pattern, possibly leaves or floral motifs. Beneath this scene, there is a block of text with several lines in a serif font. To the right of the main image, there is an oval-shaped emblem containing a shield with various symbols, surrounded by additional decorative elements. The jug itself appears to be a light or white ceramic with a single dark line near the rim and the base, and it has a large curved handle. The entire composition is rendered in grayscale.
title: Liverpool Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
